question: Which of the following singers was awarded the Padma Shri in 2024 for his significant contributions to Himachali folk and classical music?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Som Datt Battu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The singer awarded the Padma Shri in 2024 for his significant contributions to Himachali folk and classical music is **Som Dutt Battu**. 
 
• Som Dutt Battu is a renowned Hindustani classical vocalist from Shimla, Himachal Pradesh. He has dedicated his life to preserving and promoting the rich musical heritage of the region. 
 
• **Battu's contributions to music are multifaceted:**
 
• Master of Hindustani Classical Music: He is a highly accomplished vocalist in the Hindustani classical tradition, particularly known for his expertise in the Patiala Gharana.
 
• **Champion of Himachali Folk Music:** He has diligently researched and revived many traditional Himachali folk songs, ensuring their continued existence for future generations.
 
• **Dedicated Teacher and Mentor:** Battu has nurtured numerous aspiring musicians through his dedicated teaching, passing on his knowledge and passion for music. 
 
• The Padma Shri award is a prestigious civilian honor bestowed by the Government of India.
 
• It recognizes individuals who have made exceptional contributions in various fields, including art, literature, and social service.
 
• The award to Som Dutt Battu is a well-deserved recognition of his lifetime dedication to the preservation and promotion of Indian music.
